newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Banco Industrial Colombiano gets $100 mln loan.
newsitem.headline: Banco Industrial Colombiano gets $100 mln loan.

text.p: Banco Industrial Colombiano (BIC) was granted a $100 million syndicated loan in New York Friday to help boost its domestic loan portfolio, a bank official said.
Jaime Andres Lopez, a manager in BIC's international deparment, told Reuters the loan was granted by a syndicate led by Bank of America and 29 other banks from the United States, Europe and Asia.
The 39-month credit is payable at an annual interest rate of 1-1/8 percentage points above LIBOR, Lopez said.
He added that 90 percent of the credit had already been disbursed in the form of bridge loans made to BIC, Colombia's sixth-largest bank in terms of assets, late last year.
